r15b.method: Find actual indexed basename/URL by timestamp or metadata; no assumed filename regex. Preserve exact matching records, inspect HDF5 headers before power; for compatible fine products replay 982.002571 MHz ± 2500 Hz, drift ±0.15 Hz/s. If no valid product hold; filterbank rows inventory only.

r16b.method: Verify SHA256, retrieve sole frozen forward preliminary candidate; replay all six full tiles using fixed original drift, zero drift, continuous track, and wider drift corridor descriptive diagnostic ±0.2 Hz/s and ±100 Hz around fixed and extrapolated anchor. Read header coordinates from original files and compare ON/OFF. Preserve exact fixed criteria; any strong OFF match in original frozen hypotheses raises interference concern. Wider corridor is exploratory, not same-emitter proof.
r16b.scope: Same session only; archive file labels do not establish pointing independent of metadata.

r17b.source: R17 source artifacts, training R9 and development evaluation R11 (already inspected, NOT fresh prospective test).
r17b.method: Use identical frozen paired samples from R17 plus deterministic hard real OFF peak-centered patches with injected counterparts. Train standard classifier on mathematical features (blind maximum track score, persistence, drift, stationary score, spectral concentration, recurrence of peaks within patch); threshold calibrated on R9 only; compare classical baseline and hybrid on R11 without modifying production. Report per-target breakdown, no astrophysical origin labels.
r17b.claim_ceiling: Development only; even a gain requires fresh independent target exam. Unmodified controls are not known null.
